## Definition and typical features 
These studies aim to propose a new method or an improved variant of an existing method, typically including justifications, explanations, and demonstrations.

## Boundaries to related purposes

## Typical approaches and corresponding examples 
[Theory-based methods research](../approaches/1theory.qmd): prediction interval for meta-analysis;[@Higgins2009a] inverse odds weighting to operationalize transportability;[@Westreich2017transportability] adopting implementation science to the context of research methods;[@King2019using] Integrate external validity considerations in deductive causal inference.[@Esterling2025the]

[Simulation study](../approaches/2simulation.qmd): proposing an alternative to the log-rank test.[@Magirr2026robust] 

[Informal approaches](../approaches/15informal.qmd): proposal for a random invitation single arm design.[@Janiaud2025single-arm]
